description: This file contains utility classes and functions for testing Dynamo's minifier functionality within the PyTorch ecosystem. It includes dataclasses, base test classes, methods for running subprocesses, and utilities for managing test workflows related to minification, repro generation, and error checking.

classes.name: MinifierTestResult
classes.description: Dataclass to store and process results from minifier tests, including extraction of modules from code strings and exported program paths.

classes.name: MinifierTestBase
classes.description: Base test class for Dynamo minifier testing, providing setup, teardown, subprocess management, and workflow utilities for running minifier tests, reproductions, and error validation.

methods.name: str _get_module(self, t: str)
methods.description: Extracts a class module definition string from the given text using regex matching of a class Repro.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_exported_program_path(self)
methods.description: Retrieves the file path of an exported program from the repro code using regex.

methods.name: str minifier_module(self)
methods.description: Returns the module code derived from the minifier_code.

methods.name: str repro_module(self)
methods.description: Returns the module code derived from the repro_code.

methods.name: str _gen_codegen_fn_patch_code(self, device: str, bug_type: str)
methods.description: Generates code patch string to inject specific bug types into the config.

methods.name: subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes] _maybe_subprocess_run( self, args: Sequence[Any], *, isolate: bool, cwd: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Handles running subprocesses either directly or via patching the environment for isolated execution.

methods.name: tuple[subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes],Union[str,Any]] _run_test_code( self, code: str, *, isolate: bool )
methods.description: Runs code in a subprocess to test Dynamo behavior, captures stdout and stderr.

methods.name: tuple[subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes],str] _run_minifier_launcher( self, repro_dir: str, isolate: bool, *, minifier_args: Sequence[Any] = (), repro_after: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Executes the minifier launcher script within a given directory, manages flags and output.

methods.name: tuple[subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes],str] _run_repro( self, repro_dir: str, *, isolate: bool = True )
methods.description: Runs the repro script in a specified directory, returning process info and code.

methods.name: str _gen_test_code(self, run_code: str, repro_after: str, repro_level: int)
methods.description: Constructs testing code with optional repro configuration patches.

methods.name: Optional[MinifierTestResult] _run_full_test( self, run_code: str, repro_after: str, expected_error: Optional[str], *, isolate: bool, minifier_args: Sequence[Any] = (), )
methods.description: Performs the full minifier testing workflow: run original code, minify, generate repro, and validate errors.
